title: VOICE tile READ ALOUD and remote voices

clauses.text: A person decides whether text may go to a remote voice server

steps.do: Settings, Voice: choose a voice on a remote server (not this computer). In the VOICE tile READ ALOUD, paste some text and press Play. Answer the card first with No.
steps.expect: Nothing is sent while the card says No. Then choose Yes and the answer is kept for the next time.
